title: Codify reviewed learning in its owning artifacts

spec.description: Separate authoritative Git state, learned memory, session work and observed evidence. Apply Observe -> Evaluate -> Learn -> Hypothesize -> Propose -> Human decision -> Implement -> Prove -> Codify to workloads and Golden Path itself, independently of agent runtime topology. Complexity must remain justified as requirements, constraints and evidence change. The loop may add, change, retain, consolidate, replace or remove mechanisms; a justified no-change conclusion is valid. Define proof before implementation and obtain appropriate approval before consequential changes. Preserve reviewed reasoning, prior decisions and why mechanisms were changed or removed through existing canonical artifacts and Git review history, not obsolete implementation or parallel change/learning registries. Evidence may challenge architecture but never silently rewrites intent or grants execution authority.
